login.title: Ku Nghena ka Mutirhisani wa Channel
login.welcome: Mi amukeriwile ku vuya! Nghena ku lawula swiletelo swa wena.
login.heroTitle: Kurisa bindzu ra wena ra tindlu na misava hi lead yin’wana na yin’wana leyi u yi tisaka
login.heroIntro: Portal yin’we yo tsarisa vaxavi eka vaaki, hlayisa xikweleti xa swiletelo swa wena na ku va landzelela ku ya fika eku bukuteni.

register.title: Tsarisa swiletelo hi tisekoni
register.text: Rhumela muxavi wa wena na phurojeke leyi va yi tsakelaka.

protect.title: Nsirhelelo lowu phindhiweke
protect.text: Lead ya wena yi tshama yi ri ya wena eka nkarhi wa nsirhelelo, kutani a nga kona un’wana loyi a nga koxaka muxavi loyi a fanaka.

track.title: Track xiteji xin’wana na xin’wana
track.text: Vona xiyimo xa lead yin’wana na yin’wana na matimu hinkwawo, ku sukela eka ku tihlanganisa ko sungula ku ya eka ku bukuta.

handover.title: Xikweleti eka ku bukuta
handover.text: Loko muxavi a bukuta, lead yi nyiketiwa eka muaki na wena u rhekhodiwile tani hi mutirhisani wa xihlovo.

login.secure: Ku nghena hi ndlela leyi sirhelelekeke - vuxokoxoko bya vaxavi va wena byi tshama byi ri bya xihundla

signup.title: Ku Tsarisa Vatirhisani va Channel
signup.intro: Endla akhawunti ya wena ku sungula ku tsarisa na ku lawula swiletelo swa wena.
